body.text: A word, since nobody else will trouble to send you one.
Your name came up at Whitehall last week. It did not come up well.
I am not speaking of the accounts. The accounts are the Steward's affair and he will tell you about them at length. I am speaking of the impression, which is a separate thing and moves faster.
I defended you, naturally. It is not a thing I enjoy, and I should prefer not to make a habit of it.
I did not defend you. I have my own standing to think of.
You cannot answer this letter. There is nothing to answer. I mention it only so that you cannot later say nobody told you.
